title: gunpowder craft
description: Vanilla-friendly utility mod allowing you to craft gunpowder
body:
# Craftable Gunpowder & Paper

Tired of hunting down Creepers in the dark or waiting hours for sugarcane to grow? This lightweight, vanilla-friendly utility mod simplifies your survival experience by introducing custom crafting recipes for **Gunpowder** and **Paper**!

## 🚀 Features
* **Gunpowder Crafting:** Get your hands on gunpowder without the explosive danger. Perfect for TNT and firework rockets!
* **Alternative Paper Recipes:** Craft paper more efficiently to jumpstart your enchanting setups and map making.
* **Vanilla Friendly:** Designed to integrate seamlessly into the base game without breaking the survival balance.

---
